input.source: node-postgres OID 1082 decoder applied to synthetic DATE literal

sourceContracts.arbitrage: The standard announcement mapper normalizes source event_date to YYYY-MM-DD; persistence appends T00:00:00Z. A Date object is a supported defensive input to buildEventKey, but not the standard mapper output.
sourceContracts.hkDaily: Candidate list_date is selected as ::text; Tushare trade_date is YYYYMMDD and Tencent trade_date is YYYY-MM-DD. These standard call paths do not pass a PostgreSQL Date object.

reproduceCommand: At a76709d in TZ=Asia/Shanghai, create d with pg.types.getTypeParser(1082,'text')('2026-09-25'), then call isoDateSafe(d), buildEventKey({market:'HK',strategyType:'subscription',canonicalCode:'00001.HK',announcedAt:d,sourceKey:'sample'}), and hkDailyCoverage.isoDate(d).
notes: This proves the ambiguous Date fallback loses a business day when it receives a PostgreSQL DATE object.
No business table or account row was read.
